<translated_code>
import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    static final int MAXN = 300;

    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD_REAC = -3;
    static final int CAPS = ROOM;

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, rev, flow, cap;

        Edge() {
            from = 0; to = 0; rev = 0; flow = 0; cap = 0;
        }

        Edge(int f, int t, int r, int fl, int c) {
            from = f; to = t; rev = r; flow = fl; cap = c;
        }

        int residual() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static class EdmondsKarp {
        int n;
        List<Edge>[] adj;
        Edge[] parent;
        boolean[] visited;

        EdmondsKarp(int size) {
            n = size;
            adj = new List[size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            parent = new Edge[size];
            visited = new boolean[size];
        }

        void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Edge fwd = new Edge(s, t, adj[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Edge bkw = new Edge(t, s, adj[s].size(), 0, 0);
            adj[s].add(fwd);
            adj[t].add(bkw);
        }

        void addUndirected(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Edge fwd = new Edge(s, t, adj[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Edge bkw = new Edge(t, s, adj[s].size(), 0, cap);
            adj[s].add(fwd);
            adj[t].add(bkw);
        }

        boolean bfs(int src, int snk) {
            Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            Arrays.fill(parent, null);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(src);
            visited[src] = true;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == snk) return true;
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (!visited[e.to] && e.residual() > 0) {
                        visited[e.to] = true;
                        parent[e.to] = e;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int augment(int src, int snk) {
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = snk; v != src; v = parent[v].from) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, parent[v].residual());
            }
            for (int v = snk; v != src; v = parent[v].from) {
                Edge e = parent[v];
                e.flow += flow;
                adj[e.to].get(e.rev).flow -= flow;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        long maxFlow(int src, int snk) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(src, snk)) {
                total += augment(src, snk);
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int[][] grid = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] checkpoint = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] poison = new int[61][MAXN][MAXN];

    static class Point {
        int x, y, cnt;

        Point(int a, int b, int c) {
            x = a; y = b; cnt = c;
        }

        boolean inBounds(int N) {
            return x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && grid[x][y] == ROOM;
        }
    }

    static boolean valid(int x, int y, int N) {
        return new Point(x, y, 0).inBounds(N);
    }

    static List<Point> people = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Point> pods = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int decode(char c) {
        switch (c) {
            case '0': case '1': case '2': case '3': case '4':
            case '5': case '6': case '7': case '8': case '9':
                return ROOM;
            case 'Y': return REAC;
            case 'Z': return BAD_REAC;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    static int amount(char c) {
        return c - '0';
    }

    static int bfs_dist(Point src, Point dst, int N) {
        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{0, src.x, src.y});
        seen[src.x][src.y] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int t = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];

            if (x == dst.x && y == dst.y) return t;
            if (poison[t][x][y] == 1) continue;

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dx[i];
                int ny = y + dy[i];
                Point nxt = new Point(nx, ny, 0);
                if (nxt.inBounds(N) && !seen[nx][ny] && poison[t][nx][ny] == 0) {
                    q.offer(new int[]{t + 1, nx, ny});
                    seen[nx][ny] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static void spread_poison(int x, int y, int T, int N) {
        poison[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                    if (poison[t-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        poison[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int ni = i + dx[d];
                            int nj = j + dy[d];
                            if (valid(ni, nj, N)) poison[t][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();

        Point badSpot = new Point(0, 0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                String s = sc.next();
                char c = s.charAt(0);
                if (decode(c) == ROOM && amount(c) > 0) {
                    people.add(new Point(i, j, amount(c)));
                }
                grid[i][j] = decode(c);
                if (grid[i][j] == BAD_REAC) {
                    badSpot = new Point(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                String s = sc.next();
                char c = s.charAt(0);
                if (decode(c) == CAPS && amount(c) > 0) {
                    pods.add(new Point(i, j, amount(c)));
                    checkpoint[i][j] = amount(c);
                }
            }
        }

        EdmondsKarp g = new EdmondsKarp(MAXN);
        int sink = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < people.size(); ++i) {
            g.addEdge(0, i*2 + 1, people.get(i).cnt);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < pods.size(); ++i) {
            g.addEdge(i*2 + 2, sink, pods.get(i).cnt);
        }

        spread_poison(badSpot.x, badSpot.y, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < people.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < pods.size(); ++j) {
                int d = bfs_dist(people.get(i), pods.get(j), N);
                if (d <= T) {
                    g.addEdge(i*2 + 1, j*2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(g.maxFlow(0, sink));
    }
}
